## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sri Jayendhira A to Z Catering Services?
No. 19 (8/1), K.R. Koil Street, Opp. Kothandaramar Koil, West Mambalam, Chennai 600 033.

### What facilities does Sri Jayendhira A to Z Catering Services have?
Iyer & Iyengar meals, Wedding & reception catering, Engagement, Upanayanam, Seemantham & valaikappu, Naming ceremony, Puberty function, Housewarming, Pooja & homam, Varisai koodai, Flower decoration, Nadaswaram & thavil.

### Is the food pure vegetarian?
Yes. We specialise in authentic Brahmin-style pure vegetarian catering, Iyer and Iyengar.

### Do you have a hall?
Yes, Sri Srinivasa A/C Hall at our West Mambalam address, with dining, bride and groom rooms, a lift and parking.

### How do I book Sri Jayendhira A to Z Catering Services?
